title: Gọi đồ uống: ordering something to drink

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Count with me. Six —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sáu] [EN: Seven —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bảy] [EN: Eight —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tám] [EN: Nine —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chín] [EN: Ten —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: mười] [EN: And a group of ten —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chục] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi muốn một ly cà phê.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, một ly cà phê.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn chị!] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: You just heard] [VI: tôi muốn] [EN: it means I want. Listen to its two parts.] [VI_F: tôi] [EN: has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: muốn] [EN: has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: . Listen to the whole phrase again.] [VI_F: tôi muốn] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: tôi muốn] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tôi muốn] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now] [VI: cà phê] [EN: it means coffee. Listen to its two parts.] [VI_F: cà] [EN: has] [EN: a falling tone] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: phê] [EN: has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: . Listen to the whole word again.] [VI_F: cà phê] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: cà phê] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cà phê] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: And] [VI: nước] [EN: it means water. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: — high, rising. Keep your lips relaxed, not rounded, for that vowel. Listen again.] [VI_F: nước] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: nước] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: nước] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Put it together with what you know.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: tôi muốn một ly cà phê] [EN: I want one glass of coffee.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: tôi muốn một chai nước] [EN: I want one bottle of water.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I want —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tôi muốn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Coffee —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cà phê] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Water —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: nước] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. I want —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tôi muốn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Coffee —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cà phê] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Water —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: nước] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now order. I want one glass of coffee —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn một ly cà phê.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I want two bottles of water —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn hai chai nước.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I want three glasses of coffee —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn ba ly cà phê.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: tôi muốn] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: I want] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: cà phê] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: coffee] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: nước] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: water] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: tôi muốn] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: cà phê] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: nước] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: muốn] [EN: has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: , and so does] [VI: nước] [EN: .]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi muốn một ly cà phê.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, một ly cà phê.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn chị!] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Order one bottle of water.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn một chai nước.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, you will learn to say a dish is tasty, or too spicy. One word to start —] [VI: ngon] [EN: it means tasty. See you then.]
